notes: The tuition figure of 178 EUR/year comes from the Parcoursup fiche and matches the rate for EU/French students in the page; the Campus France page states non-EU applicants pay differentiated fees of 2 902 EUR/year in a Licence cycle, but that page is about general French public institutions, not this specific programme, so it is not recorded as this programme's tuition. Quoted evidence for this programme only states 'Par année 178 euros.' The French B2 level is listed under 'Langues et options' as the level required to enrol; it is treated as a requirement since it is stated as 'requis'. An interview is part of the selection ('Les épreuves de sélection').

note.fr: Un entretien oral (téléphone, visioconférence ou présentiel) peut être organisé pour apprécier votre motivation. Préparez-vous à en parler lors de la procédure Études en France.
note.en: An interview (phone, videoconference or in-person) may be held to assess your motivation. Be prepared to address it during the Études en France procedure.

evidence.quote: Cet entretien a pour objectif d'apprécier la motivation du candidat et de répondre à ses questions concernant la formation ou la vie sur le campus.
